summary.text: Omar Aquino is a Democratic member of the Illinois State Senate who has represented District 2 since 2017 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He was born and raised on the northwest side of Chicago.

paragraphs.text: Aquino earned a bachelor's degree in criminal justice and sociology from Loyola University Chicago.

His work experience includes serving as a bilingual case manager at the Jane Addams School of Social Work, as a legislative assistant in the Illinois House of Representatives, and as an outreach coordinator for Congresswoman Tammy Duckworth.
Aquino succeeded William Delgado in the Illinois State Senate and took office in 2017.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on March 17, 2026.
